visual_description: A bundle of four pointed wooden lath stakes (flat, thin wood). One stake is driven into the ground with a long tail of 'Fluorescent Pink' plastic survey tape tied to the top, fluttering in the wind. The tape is printed with the words 'SCIENTIFIC STUDY AREA - DO NOT DISTURB'.

constraints.material: Unfinished splintery pine wood; thin crinkled plastic tape.
constraints.background: Dry, cracked earth with sagebrush at the base.
